verdict.rationale: Mapping touch and stylus input to host pointer events is a fair question for a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes touch or stylus input translation from a mobile client to the host. The Mobile SDK add-on and mobile device management items are adjacent features and do not address input mapping.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host
